name: Configurable Experience
teaser: Configure the skill experience multiplier and toggle skill fatigue.
description_html:
HOW IT WORKS:

  • Adds the possibility to change the default skill multiplier.
  • Adds the possibility to enable/disable the skill fatigue system.

You can enable/disable the changes to the skill fatigue system alongside the default skill multiplier using the in-game config menu (F12)

Note: Since metabolism XP rewards are very high by default, I added the possibility to disable the multiplier for the metabolism skill.

CHANGES FROM VANILLA:

  • The Skill fatigue system is disabled by default.

FUTURE ADDITIONS:

  • Add the possibility to configure the multiplier for each individual Skill.

Big thanks to everyone, hope you guys enjoy and remember to report any bug/suggestion in the comments!
